meta.title: Restaurant Management System | Complete Cloud Software
meta.description: All-in-one restaurant & hotel management software with billing, inventory, staff, booking and analytics in one cloud platform.

hero.headline: Smart Restaurant & Hotel Management
hero.subLine: Manage billing, bookings, staff, inventory and customer experience from one powerful cloud platform built for modern restaurants and hotels.

items.title: Cloud Setup
items.description: Complete cloud system to manage rooms, billing, staff and operations from anywhere.

items.title: Check-in / Check-out
items.description: Quick guest check-in and check-out with photo capture and digital records.

items.title: Live Room Status
items.description: Real-time room availability and booking tray for clear room tracking.

items.title: Advance Booking
items.description: Manage future reservations, walk-ins and online bookings easily.

items.title: Housekeeping App
items.description: Assign and track housekeeping tasks with mobile access.

items.title: Accounts
items.description: Track expenses, income, reports and financial summaries in one place.

items.title: Staff Management
items.description: Manage roles, attendance, salaries and performance with ease.

items.title: Inventory
items.description: Monitor stock, purchases and usage with real-time alerts.

items.title: Restaurant POS
items.description: Integrated POS for dine-in, takeaway and online orders.

items.title: Channel Manager
items.description: Sync rooms and pricing across booking platforms automatically.

items.title: Booking Engine
items.description: Accept direct bookings from your website with live availability.

items.title: Banquet Module
items.description: Manage events, halls, catering and payments from one dashboard.

blocks.content: Fully customizable software tailored to your restaurant or hotel workflow. Simple, fast and scalable for growing businesses.
